feeds.title: Southeast Corgi Rescue Blog
feeds.description: We are an all-volunteer, registered nonprofit dedicated to finding homes for rescued corgis and corgi mixes where they can live, love, be loved, and thrive in North Carolina, South Carolina, and Georgia. We share our experiences, rescues, funding, and more.

feeds.title: Rocky Kanaka » Corgi
feeds.description: Read about the Royal family's obsession with Corgis, food for Corgi, different Corgi comparisons, and more. Rocky Kanaka is a Pet Rescue Advocate. He travels North America raising awareness about homeless pets so they can find their forever homes. He believes that every dog deserves a loving home.

feeds.title: Pembroke Welsh Corgis Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to PemberDiamonds, a KUSA-registered breeder of Pembroke Welsh Corgis. We take great pride in our breeding program and strive to provide loving homes with healthy and well-adjusted Corgis. With years of experience and a deep commitment to the breed, we are dedicated to producing exceptional puppies that will bring joy and companionship to their new families.

feeds.title: Breeder's Valley
feeds.description: Discover the essential guide to adopting your first pawwy friend! Find Do's and Don'ts list, and training manuals for healthy, well-mannered Corgi puppies. Breedersvalley.com is your go-to destination for top-quality corgi puppies, dedicated to producing healthy, happy, and well-socialized corgis that make wonderful pets.

feeds.title: Everyone Loves a Corgi Blog
feeds.description: We are a San Francisco-based Meetup group that hosts monthly meetups for Corgis and their owners at venues across the Bay Area. We also host annual traditions and other events for Corgi parents and lovers. This blog is dedicated to Corgi stories, good and bad, happy and sad.

feeds.title: Three Corgis Blog
feeds.description: Three Corgis is an all-Corgi shop and blog. You will find interesting articles and creative apparel, accessories, gifts, and so much more. The blog has articles for healthy pets, artists, cupcakes, and more.

feeds.title: LaCorgi Blog
feeds.description: LaCorgi.co was founded in 2018 by Geordi La Corgi, stemming from his relentless drive and passion for providing uniquely beautiful products to the aesthetes. We post informative articles and tips for taking care of your corgis.

feeds.title: F&M Corgi's Blog
feeds.description: My name is Michelle Horning, and my husband, Frank, and I have been lovingly breeding and raising Pembroke & Cardigan Welsh Corgis for years. They are perfect dogs for families with children. Check out our Blog for a guide on the differences between Pembroke and Cardigan Welsh Corgis.

feeds.title: Capriccio Corgis Blog
feeds.description: If you've ever wanted to follow a breeder's day-by-day activities, here's the place to do it! Looking forward to sharing my adventures and learnings with future puppy owners, as well as others passionate about well-bred and purebred dogs.

feeds.title: Petorama Blog » Corgi
feeds.description: Read about Corgi's history, famous owners, rescue, adoption, and more. We created PETORAMA so you can celebrate the bond you share with your pet through modern, high-quality products you're proud to display in your home. We are an exclusive online destination for breed-specific, high-quality, customizable pet gifts.

feeds.title: Willo The Corgi Blog
feeds.description: Devon is Willo's mom, an Arizona native working in advertising. She is a graphic and website designer, and she has a passion for photography. She shares her life insights with Willo on this blog. Find corgi puppy tips, pet-friendly places and hotels, and corgi facts. Learn how to train your corgi puppy not to bite in the latest post!

feeds.title: Navy Corgi
feeds.description: We are Alex and Zach, the humans behind Navy Corgi. Our goal is to help our readers, whether new or seasoned dog parents, lead a more dog-friendly lifestyle. Navy Corgi is a dog-friendly lifestyle blog by Navy the Corgi. This blog focuses on product reviews, travel, fun DIYs, and all our amazing adventures.

feeds.title: Marcel Le Corgi Blog
feeds.description: My name is Marcel 'Le Corgi' and I'm a fluffy Pembroke Welsh corgi pup living in London (UK) with two Frenchies. I'm here to make you smile and inspire you to explore more with your well-behaved humans.
